description: Official Hytale dedicated server from Hypixel Studios (Java 25, QUIC over UDP). The first start signs in with your Hytale account and downloads the official server files.
author: AnxOS

lines: # Generated by AnxOS. Starts the official Hytale server layout. On the first
# start it runs Hytale's own bootstrap: you sign in with your Hytale account and
# the official server files and assets download into this folder.
# ANXOS_HYTALE_JAVA (instance environment) selects a specific Java first.
echo "[AnxOS] Hytale needs Java 25 or newer and none was found on this node. Install Java 25 (for example Eclipse Temurin 25), then start the server again." >&2
echo "[AnxOS] HytaleServer.jar is missing, so the server files cannot be set up. Reinstall this instance from the Marketplace." >&2
# Hytale's bootstrap mode cannot create a missing permissions.json (verified
# with 0.7.5), so an empty one is provided for it.
echo "[AnxOS] First start: Hytale server setup."
echo "[AnxOS] 1. Open the link below and approve this server with your Hytale account."
echo "[AnxOS] 2. AnxOS then runs 'update download' to fetch the official server files and assets (several GB)."
# Forward console input to the server, and send 'update download' once the
# sign-in has succeeded (the device login does not block boot commands).
while ! grep -q "Authentication successful" .anxos-bootstrap.log 2>/dev/null; do sleep 2; done
echo "[AnxOS] Hytale setup stopped (exit code $status) before the server files were downloaded." >&2
echo "[AnxOS] Hytale setup ended without the server files. Start the server again to retry the sign-in and download." >&2
echo "[AnxOS] Server files downloaded. Starting the Hytale server."
# JVM arguments for the official Hytale start.sh (one per line).

windows.comingSoonMessage: Hytale servers on Windows nodes are not supported by AnxOS yet. Install it on a Linux node.

installMetadata.notes: Downloads HytaleServer.jar from Hypixel Studios' official Maven repository and verifies its SHA-1. The first start runs Hytale's bootstrap: sign in with your Hytale account through the link in the console, then AnxOS fetches the server files and assets. Needs Java 25 and UDP port forwarding (QUIC).

configNotes: Server settings live in Server/config.json, worlds in Server/universe and mods in Server/mods. Hytale rewrites config files while running, so stop the server before editing them. Players connect over UDP, so forward the UDP port.
